label: disconnect

limitations: RSS is sampled aggregate resident memory, not unique/private memory; shared pages may be counted repeatedly.
Short-lived children or their final CPU/RSS peak between 100ms samples can be missed; CPU is an observed estimate.
Includes observed descendants of the Downie root; system-managed/reparented WebKit or translation services may be excluded; unrelated research Electron and fixture server are excluded.

conditions: Official documented downie:// URL scheme invoked by open -a exact installed app path.
Existing user profile, empty queue at start; research destination and temporary concurrency=1, connections=1, quality limit720p.
Output detection is a 100ms polled non-empty final-extension file, stable for800ms, with post-hoc ffprobe; not a UI completion milestone.
Warm already-running app. CPU is sampled estimate; RSS is summed process family; XPC WebKit processes reparented to launchd may not be captured.
